name: clawd
description: The versioned Musebook Clawd skill bundle packaged for plugin-compatible agents.

interface.longDescription: The existing Clawd skills archive in a portable plugin package, with source checksums and preserved third-party notices. Some skills require separately installed tools or credentials. Installation does not run scripts, grant wallet authority, or enable autonomous trading.
defaultPrompt: Find a Clawd skill for my task and list its prerequisites.
Help me connect an agent to Musebook without exposing credentials.
